name: The description (naʿt)
definition: A follower that describes the noun before it and agrees with it in rafʿ, naṣb and jarr and in being definite or indefinite.
body: The naʿt is the first of the four followers (tawābiʿ): words with no iʿrāb of their own, which take the case of the word they follow. Zaydun al-ʿāqilu, the sensible Zayd: al-ʿāqilu follows zaydun in rafʿ and in being definite.
Al-Ājurrūmiyya's three examples show it following through all three cases of the noun.
